SourceProject.description: Saved .tasproj path, relative to this configuration or absolute.

Project.description: C# class library .csproj, relative to this configuration or absolute.

TypeName.description: Full name of the public IExperiment class.

Count.description: Total trials (positive 32-bit integer). There is no 10,000-trial cap; Parallelism limits simultaneous workers.

Headless.description: False opens a read-only game preview for each active trial. Closing a preview cancels only that trial.

StateId.description: For SaveState, use project-start for the embedded project baseline, or a saved state/checkpoint marker ID.

TopPlays.description: Optional retention of the best K playable paths. Omit to retain scores only.

ScoreField.description: Exact JSON result member used for automatic capture. Explicit SubmitPlayAsync calls supply their own finite double score.
